versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Time Management skill for solopreneurs.

- Playbook covers time-blocking, deep work, energy management, distraction elimination, and productivity systems.
- Includes a 6-step framework: time audit, time-blocking, deep work protection, energy management, distraction/context-switch reduction, and 80/20 prioritization.
- Provides practical schedules, rules for peak productivity, and actionable tactics for balancing all aspects of solo business management.
- Activation triggers: "time management", "productivity", "focus", "get more done", "manage my time", "deep work", "avoid burnout", "daily routine".
